primary_meaning: strength, majesty, durability, and the flourishing of the righteous

alternatives.meaning: human pride and loftiness that God humbles
the messianic kingdom or exalted tree of God’s planting
purification and incorruptibility (ritual use of cedar wood)

notes: Cedars of Lebanon dominate biblical references; Christian teaching most often links them positively to strength and the righteous (via Ps 92), yet context can reverse the image to pride. Multiple secondary associations exist without one exclusive settled meaning.
